channel.title: Newspin: the week in review
channel.description: Every Monday: the stories that moved on Newspin last week.

item.title: The week in review, 16–22 Nov 2026
item.description:
Nvidia & Huang: Huang to testify in public before the Senate Banking Committee; no date set; Reuters: SEC staff examining possible accounting issues at Nvidia; shares fall 14%; California's attorney general subpoenas Nvidia; Shares fall about 3% the day after results (and 7 more)

Delhi air: Sunday morning: AQI eases to 237, with five stations 'very poor'; Saturday morning: AQI 278, with 25 stations 'very poor'; Friday morning: AQI eases to 269 on the season's coldest morning; Thursday morning: AQI rises to 289, near the 'very poor' line (and 4 more)

West Asia & oil: Bahrain says two people were hurt in Saturday's Iranian attack on an industrial plant; Two tankers hit leaving Hormuz; Iran fires missiles and drones at US bases in Bahrain; Iran's Revolutionary Guards say they shot down a US drone over Hormuz; Brent settles at $92.57, ending a third weekly fall (and 4 more)

Anthropic: Anthropic mathematician claims a Riemann Hypothesis proof made with Claude; not yet verified; Shares fall back towards the IPO price on day two; Anthropic starts trading on Nasdaq; shares close 17% above the IPO price; IPO reportedly priced at $83 a share, above the range (and 1 more)

OpenAI: OpenAI says its models helped improve AMD chip designs; Oregon sues over child safety; GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol; Sued by California over AI safety

Google Gemini: Gemini for Mac can now use apps for you; Genie 4 world model opens to Ultra subscribers; Gemini 4 Neon, a mid-priced model between Carbon and Hydrogen; Gemini to keep 'history off' chats for about two months

SpiceJet: DGCA issues a show-cause notice; shares hit the lower limit; About three in four SpiceJet flights at the top three airports don't operate; Board approves raising up to ₹5,500 crore; No SpiceJet departures from Mumbai for more than 12 hours

Ukraine talks: Ukraine says its sea drones hit a Russian warship in a Libyan port, 2,400 km from the front; Russian strikes on Kyiv region hit an apartment block and a supermarket; Zelenskyy asks the US for Patriot missiles

US shutdown deadline: Iran war splits Democrats ahead of the 11 December deadline; Stopgap law keeps the government open to 11 December

Starship: Debris on a Mexican beach; SpaceX says it found very little; The tower catches the ship

China's AI labs: Nvidia stops shipping US-approved H200 chips to China; Alibaba releases Qwen4-Max, its new flagship

Apple: Record share price as Apple stays the world's most valuable company; First close above $5 trillion

US markets: S&P 500 falls 3.7% for a seventh straight loss and enters a correction; Nasdaq turns negative for 2026 (plus 1 earlier daily wraps)

Outlook outage: Microsoft's preliminary report: a months-old hidden bug

US ground stop: White House cyber director removed after a string of outages; FAA pauses router installs; cause still unknown and oversight disputed; Monday morning: a few hundred cancellations, American hit hardest; Sunday ends with about 2,100 cancellations; Monday looks close to normal (and 1 more)

Rupee: Rupee crosses 93 and closes at a seven-month high of 92.67; Rises to 93.63 as oil falls and foreign money flows in; Edges up to 94.13 as oil eases

Founder comebacks: Huang says he would be 'honored' to return; the board chair says no; Reports say Huang is discussing a comeback

India markets: Banks pull Nifty back from a weak open to close above 25,800 (plus 1 earlier daily wraps)

Inflation: Wholesale inflation rises to 12.29%, led by fuel and power

Budget 2027: Finance Minister begins pre-Budget meetings with industry and experts

RBI rates: Reuters poll: most economists expect a December hike to 5.75%

US midterms: AP calls Alaska's Senate race for Peltola, the last Senate race to be decided

US trade deal: Commerce Secretary: deal 'more or less finalised' but can't be signed until new US tariff rules are in place

Air India 171: Government asks the Supreme Court for two to three more weeks

Meta AI: Reuters reports privacy slips by the Muse agent

xAI & Grok: About 60 jobs reportedly cut from the Grok Imagine video team

Russian oil: Russian oil set for a smaller share in November as discounts return

Online gaming: Supreme Court to hear the challenge to the ban on 2 December

item.title: The week in review, 9–15 Nov 2026
item.description:
Nvidia & Huang: Who might replace Huang: Trump backs Tim Cook; other names floated; Market value falls below $4 trillion; Lawyers, a chip-smuggling probe and a CEO search; Reports: the board pushed him out (and 6 more)

West Asia & oil: Oil ends a second losing week; IEA sees a surplus; Trump says no deal needed; oil jumps 3%; Brent briefly drops below $90; Iran's Hormuz plan goes to the White House

Rupee: Slips to 94.20 on US rate worries; A small pullback from the high; A six-month high of 93.70

Google Gemini: Gemini 4 Hydrogen, the new everyday model; AlphaGenome 2 and a lawsuit

SpiceJet: Stock exchange warns of a trading halt; SpiceJet promises results by 7 December; Board to consider raising money

Flying this winter: US flights halted for four hours; Delhi airport's first low-visibility procedures of the season

Airfares & fuel: New rules let the government cap fares; Supreme Court: "Don't travel by air"

Air India 171: Draft to be filed in a sealed cover in October; AAIB to Supreme Court: draft report around October

India AI rules: Questions over home footage used to train robots; Push for Indian AI in critical sectors

Outlook outage: Microsoft's preliminary report: a months-old hidden bug; Microsoft names a cause and apologises

Inflation: October inflation hits 6.09%, above the RBI's limit

US ground stop: Third day of disruption; Duffy expects "fully normal" flights by Monday; Saturday ends with about 6,400 cancellations; more than 900 Sunday flights already cancelled

Delhi air: Light rain and wind: AQI improves to 'poor' by Sunday afternoon; Sunday morning: still 'very poor', smog over the city

OpenAI: ChatGPT Wallet and security agents; Sued, and TSMC invests

Anthropic: IPO reportedly six times oversubscribed; Named in AI freeze lawsuit

US midterms: Where the count stands; Trump: 'I have total veto power'

Meta AI: Named in AI freeze lawsuit; Muse Ember, a low-cost worker model

xAI & Grok: About 60 jobs reportedly cut from the Grok Imagine video team; Named in AI freeze lawsuit

China's AI labs: ByteDance: frontier parity by 2029–30; Meituan opens up LongCat-2.5, a 1.6-trillion-parameter agent model

Budget 2027: Diesel support costs ₹14,000 crore a month, PM says

RBI rates: Inflation crosses 6% before the December meeting

US trade deal: Goyal: India will have one of the 'best' deals

Russian oil: Gulf overtakes Russia for the first time since the war

Electricity policy: CAG starts an audit of 39 state power distributors

item.title: The week in review, 2–8 Nov 2026
item.description:
US trade deal: Still no signed deal

Nvidia & Huang: Board opens independent investigation; Huang admits infidelity; Incoming Democratic majority signals its own questions; House committee chairs ask Huang for a closed-door briefing

item.title: The week in review, 26 Oct – 1 Nov 2026
item.description:
Budget 2027: Half-year deficit runs ahead of last year

Digi Yatra: International trials begin at seven airports

Nvidia & Huang: New York Times report: Huang targeted by Chinese intelligence

item.title: The week in review, 12–18 Oct 2026
item.description:
Inflation: September inflation jumps to 5.54%

Budget 2027: Pre-Budget meetings with ministries begin
